en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a grassy meadow leading up to a row of large, ornate villas at the edge of a forested hillside. The architecture is early‑20th‑century Central European, with steep, complex roofs, balconies, bay windows, and window shutters. One villa, on the right, has signage on its facade and striped window awnings, suggesting it may be a guesthouse or pension. A narrow path or road runs along the base of the houses. The whole scene has a calm, rural, small‑spa‑town atmosphere.
